note: Captured from the Nereus full stack (sim.launch.py active_control_model:=mpc mpc_model:=sim, robosub pool, rmw_zenoh_cpp) on a desktop under heavy load (other jobs running): rates are what this machine delivered, not robot specs. Each topic was measured alone for 3s with a best-effort subscription (rate_hz: pass 1, robot holding still before the tree run; rate_hz_pass2: pass 2, holding still after it); 0 = no message in that window, null = no publisher. sim_configured_hz is the rate the Nereus bridge is configured to publish at (0 = published on events, not on a timer; /clock is published every 2 ms physics step). On the real robot the topics the simulator publishes come from the sensor drivers and the firmware (micro-ROS) instead.

nodes.label: nereus_viewer
nodes.role: Pool viewer: 3D scene, camera cards, scorecard, prior map editor.

nodes.label: nereus_viewer_timing
nodes.role: Viewer helper node (clock / timing).

nodes.label: riptide_acoustics
nodes.role: Acoustics (pinger) node. Nereus does not simulate acoustics.

nodes.label: sim_supervisor
nodes.role: Starts nereus-sim and restarts it in another pool when the viewer asks.

nodes.label: ActuatorTranslator
nodes.role: Translates actuator services from the trees into actuator command topics.

nodes.label: tag_container
nodes.role: Container for the AprilTag detector (on the robot started by hardware.launch.py; in sim added by Nereus mission_stack.launch.py).

nodes.label: apriltag_36h11
nodes.role: AprilTag (36h11) detector on the front camera, for tag calibration of the map.

nodes.label: autonomy
nodes.role: Behavior-tree executor: autonomy/run_tree action, publishes the running stack.

nodes.label: calibrate_drag
nodes.role: Drag calibration action server (calibrate_drag_new).

nodes.label: controller_overseer
nodes.role: Controller supervisor: publishes controller/motion_enabled and the feed-forward body force, hosts parameter-update services for the older controllers, warns when thruster telemetry stops.

nodes.label: depth_converter
nodes.role: Turns the raw pressure depth into a pose for the EKF.

nodes.label: ekf_localization_node
nodes.role: EKF: fuses IMU, FOG, DVL and depth into odometry/filtered and the odom->base_link transform.

nodes.label: joint_state_publisher
nodes.role: Joint states for the robot description.

nodes.label: mpc_controller
nodes.role: Model predictive controller: pose/velocity targets in, eight thruster forces out.

nodes.label: odom_to_world_broadcaster
nodes.role: Static world->odom transform.

nodes.label: physics_simulator
nodes.role: Nereus simulator: 6-DOF physics, sensors (IMU, FOG, DVL, depth), both ZED cameras, actuators, task scoring. Stands in for the firmware boards and sensor drivers.

nodes.label: riptide_mapping2
nodes.role: Mapping: fuses detections into one pose estimate per course object (mapping/<object>, TF frames).

nodes.label: robot_state_publisher
nodes.role: Publishes the robot description and the sensor/thruster frames on Talos.

nodes.label: surface_frame_node
nodes.role: Static tag36h11:0 -> estimated_origin_frame transform.

nodes.label: viewer_panels
nodes.role: Viewer operator panels: Enable/KILL (software kill slot 1), Motion, Autonomy, Mapping, Actuators, Electrical, Recording, Bagging.

nodes.label: viewer_plots
nodes.role: Viewer plot windows (subscribes only to plotted topics).

nodes.label: world_to_map
nodes.role: Publishes world->map on /tf_static; the map/set_transform service and map/model_tf action move it (AprilTag calibration).

nodes.label: yolo_orientation
nodes.role: YOLO detector on the active camera (ffc or dfc): detections with 3D poses from depth.
